title: Threat decomposition & secrets playbook sync
body:
Attendees: Maya, Ethan, Priya, Liam, Noah (20m sync + 10m deep dive)
Meeting goal: reconcile open vulnerabilities with secrets inventory status, and validate next steps in the threats decomposition for recent product changes (private deploy agent auth flow).

Summary / tl;dr:
- We mapped three mid-priority findings from last week's vuln sweep to specific threat primitives in the playbook (man-in-the-middle of control-plane traffic, stale secrets in CI logs, excessive vault ACLs).
- Secrets migration to centralized Vault v2 is ~65% done; primary blocker is service-token rotation for dedupe-service and queued tasks worker.
- Decision: postpone automated canary rotation for dedupe-service until after staging e2e tests (to avoid accidental job failures). Manual rotation and monitoring will be used in the interim.

Vulnerability triage highlights (short notes):
- VULN-2026-211 (control-plane TLS misconfig on legacy proxy): severity = high -> action: short-term mitigation by enforcing TLS1.2+ on edge proxy and adding packet capture sentinel; long-term fix scheduled in infra sprint (owner: Liam, due 2026-08-12).
- VULN-2026-218 (secrets in archived CI logs): severity = medium -> action: run targeted purge for logs containing auth tokens + add pre-merge linter to block token patterns (owner: Priya for purge, Ethan for linter, due 2026-08-05).
- VULN-2026-224 (overly broad Vault policies for staging team): severity = medium-low -> action: create scoped policy templates and gradually apply least-privilege (owner: Noah, due 2026-08-19).

Secrets inventory & migration status:
- Central Vault v2 migration: 65% completed. Remaining items: dedupe-service, ai-eval-runner, and a set of legacy Jenkins jobs.
- Dedupe-service rotation plan: manual rotate keys this week, then run smoke tests; automated rotation to be re-evaluated after staging pass.
- Jenkins archive review: found ~12 potential high-risk artifacts with embedded tokens; scheduled purge job (Priya).
- Service-account consolidation: discovered 9 duplicate service accounts across projects; agreed to consolidate 5 by end of next sprint.

Threat decomposition notes (private deploy agent auth flow):
- Attack surface break-down: control-plane handshake, agent bootstrap, config delivery, cached credentials on agent host.
- Top threat scenarios: a) compromised bootstrap token -> lateral movement on customer LAN; b) MITM during config delivery -> config tampering; c) stale caches exposing tokens -> exfiltration.
- Risk controls currently in place: short-lived bootstrap tokens, signed manifests, mTLS between agent and control plane (not consistently enabled for older regions).
- Gaps identified: non-uniform mTLS enforcement in eu-west-2 and us-west-2 regions; lacking runtime telemetry for agent-side cache reads.

Decisions made in this sync:
- Enforce mTLS-by-default in all new agent deployments and schedule retrofit for existing fleets (owner: Liam, due 2026-09-02).
- Add an agent telemetry event for "cache-secret-read" with sampling to avoid cost explosion (owner: Maya, PR to change proto by 2026-08-03).
- Create a short-lived token guideline for partner integrations (doc draft -> CON-1192 owner: Priya, ready for review 2026-08-09).

Action items (owners and dates):
- Priya: run CI log purge for candidate artifacts and open purge job -> due 2026-08-05.
- Ethan: implement token-pattern pre-merge linter + test on one repo -> due 2026-08-05.
- Liam: enforce TLS config on legacy proxy and kickoff mTLS retrofit plan -> short-term TLS fix due 2026-08-12; mTLS retrofit plan due 2026-09-02.
- Noah: draft scoped Vault policy templates and start staged application in staging -> due 2026-08-19.
- Maya: add agent telemetry proto change + spike on storage/ingest costs -> PR by 2026-08-03, cost spike report by 2026-08-10.

Open questions & risks:
- Will manual rotation of dedupe-service keys cause job failures not covered by current tests? (Mitigation: run canary jobs against a mirrored queue in staging).
- Do we have legal/regulatory constraints on rotating customer-provided certs for private deploys? Need compliance check (linked: SEC-452).
- Vault quota/throughput under large-scale rotation (planning spike needed) -> follow-up with infra perf team.

Notes for next sync (2026-08-05):
- Short review of purge results + linter rollout metrics.
- Staging e2e backup plan for dedupe-service rotation (include runbook).
- Progress check on mTLS retrofit plan + estimated outage window for older regions.

Misc (notes-to-self / low-priority):
- Consider adding a "secrets-aging" telemetry (alert when secret TTL < X days) tied to Slack incident channel.
- Tag related PRs with SEC-AUDIT for faster review during rotation windows.

End of notes.
